question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

He asked me __if I have anything__ to say.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'if I had anything'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is incorrect.
 
• Here, **'if I had anything'** should be used instead of** 'if I have anything'.**
 
• In reported speech, **the reporting verb** ("**asked**") is usually followed by a past tense form, especially when the reported speech itself is in** the past tense.**
 
• Therefore, in this case, ***"if I had anything"*** is the appropriate choice for** indirect reported speech**, where the present tense "**have**" changes to the past tense **"had."** 

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He asked me **if I had anything** to say.*
